_comment: DEVELOPMENT PROFILE, NOT A MACHINE (added 2026-09-30 at the operator's request). The reference machine's geometry, with two values changed so the slicer can be developed against the mechanical team's target before the CAD model exists: max_tilt_angle_deg 60 (the goal, a cone: 60 degrees total in any direction, operator 2026-09-30) and nozzle_cone_angle_deg 60 (the widest nozzle cone that lets the field use 60 degrees: 90 - 60/2 = 60; a requirement on the hotend, not a measured nozzle). Everything else is reference.json. The reference geometry cannot use large tilts near the bed without lifting the part (plan_corrections 7c P2-10): G-code made with this profile is for inspection only. Select it with ATOM_MACHINE=dev60.
_gate: M2 (the real tilt limit and its shape) and M3 (the real nozzle); M1 for the geometry
name: dev60
